description: Proof that an uploaded file was stored intact and read completely, from durable bytes through to a searchable index.

metrics.description: The SHA-256 the worker computes after downloading a file equals the SHA-256 computed at upload.
metrics.measurementMethod: Hash the bytes received at upload, store the digest on the file version, hash again after the worker reads the object back from durable storage, and compare. 1 when equal.

metrics.description: Every page, slide or sheet the source declares is present in the parsed document.
metrics.measurementMethod: parsedUnits / sourceUnits, where sourceUnits is the container's own declared count (PDF page tree, pptx slide parts, workbook sheets).

metrics.description: The number of rendered preview pages equals the number of parsed pages.
metrics.measurementMethod: previewPageCount / parsedPageCount for documents that are rendered to page images.

metrics.description: Share of eligible extracted text that is reachable through at least one indexed passage.
metrics.measurementMethod: Sum of characters covered by chunk ranges divided by total extracted characters across all document units, counting overlap once.

metrics.description: Share of indexed passages that carry a usable embedding vector.
metrics.measurementMethod: chunks with a non-null embedding of the expected dimensionality divided by total chunks for the file version.

metrics.description: Reader confidence for a page whose text had to be recovered from the rendered image.
metrics.measurementMethod: Deterministic legibility score over the recovered text: proportion of dictionary-shaped words, letter ratio, and text coverage relative to the page's ink area.

metrics.description: Share of uploaded files that reach a searchable, viewable state.
metrics.measurementMethod: files with status READY divided by files that are not archive containers, over the reporting window.
